thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: continuous-batching latency spike detected in us-east-1. p95 tokens/sec down 60% over last 30s. KV cache eviction rate up 8x. Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall triggered.

maria: seeing the same on the dashboard — queue length ramped and microbatch sizes collapsed. looks like prefetch + cb combo.

ajay: which rollout touched batching params? I pushed a microbatch heuristic tweak ~20m ago (reduce target microbatch to 8 for short requests).

maria: that lines up. under high concurrency it seems to be starving longer requests and thrashing the kv cache. eviction log: `evict_ratio=0.82, evict_rate=1234/s`

sam: confirmed customer-facing errors: a handful of requests returned 503s and long tails. Customer Impact: intermittent failures for high-throughput teams, ~2% error spike. cc @lia for downstream comms.

lia: noted — I'll draft a brief but will hold until we know mitigation.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause the microbatch heuristic rollout, 2) bump microbatch target back to 32 for cb workers, 3) enable kv-prefetch backpressure throttle. do we have a one-line helm patch?

ajay: applying hotfix to config map now. patch: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  cb.microbatch_target: "32"
  cb.prefetch_enabled: "true"
  cb.prefetch_backpressure_threshold: "0.75"
```

maria: nice. rolling to 20% canary first, then 100% if metrics look good. ops-oncall, can you hold capacity for quick rollback windows?

ops-oncall: holding. reserved extra pool and bumped scale target. watching.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by ajay for configmap/continuous-batch-hotfix (canary=20%). Roll ID: deploy-4951236789-1.

maria: telemetry check commands: `curl -s http://metrics/api/p95?service=cb&region=us-east-1` and `kubectl logs -l job=cb-worker --since=1m | grep evict` — watch p95 and evict_rate.

ajay: canary reports after 30s: p95 improved from 420ms -> 180ms on canary nodes; evict_rate dropped 70%. queue depth also normalized.

sam: customer error rate dropping. Triage note: degraded for ~12 minutes, peak errors ~2.1%. No major data loss.

lia: sending short status to affected customers: "We're seeing an intermittent inference latency spike tied to batching heuristics — a targeted rollback is in progress and we expect normal service within minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem." Shall I send now?

maria: wait until canary hits 100% or we confirm metrics stable for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded. progressing to 100% rollout. Roll ID: deploy-4951236789-2.

ajay: 100% rolled. p95 steady ~170ms, evict_rate baseline.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Condition cleared for continuous-batching latency spike in us-east-1. Incident duration: ~18m.

maria: postmortem action items: 1) revert microbatch heuristic PR until we have load-safety tests, 2) add a circuit that prevents microbatch shrink below N for workloads with heavy kv density, 3) add alert for evict_rate > 3x baseline with automatic prefetch-throttle, 4) run chaos test with high concurrency to reproduce.

ajay: I'll open the revert PR and add perf test cases to the CI harness.

ops-oncall: handing off to night shift — ops-oncall (night) is assigned. I left runbook notes and current dashboard links in the thread.

lia: sending customer notes now. will include ETA + blameless summary later.

sam: thanks team. ping me if any regressions.

maria: logging this for the oncall rotation handoff: https://redwood.app/dashboards/cb-us-east-1?start=-30m — metrics to watch: cb.queue_depth, cb.microbatch_size, kvcache.evict_rate, infra.cpu.

ajay: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/changes/4589 revert microbatch heuristics.

maria: closing out here — follow-up postmortem to be scheduled for tomorrow 10:30 PT.

ops-oncall: acknowledged, handing off. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager closed for thread 4951236789."
